page_title: PSG 3-1 AUX | PSG v Auxerre 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Abdelatif Kherradji is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' 3 - 1 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
86' The expression of the referee Abdelatif Kherradji is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is shown a yellow card.
84' Substitution. Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Han-Noah Massengo walks off.
84' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Lassine Sinayoko and he is replaced by Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
84' Here comes a substitution. Florian Aye (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Gaetan Perrin.
84' What a magnificent shot by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG). Unfortunately for him, his free kick effort rattles the right post.
80' Donovan Leon anticipates the direction of the penalty by Goncalo Ramos (PSG). He attempted to put the ball inside the right post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
79' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
79' Nuno Mendes (PSG) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
79' Nuno Mendes (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul. PSG are awarded a penalty kick!
78' Nuno Mendes (PSG) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
77' Today's referee Abdelatif Kherradji rightly decides to book Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) for his harsh tackle.
74' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Lucas Beraldo (PSG) replaces Marquinhos.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) will replace Ousmane Dembele.
73' The linesman raises his flag. Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) is adjudged offside.
72' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. That's a free kick to Auxerre.
71' Christophe Pelissier decides to make a substitution. Hamed Junior Traore will be replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Clement Akpa leaves the pitch and Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) comes on.
67' 2 - 1 Marquinhos (PSG) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 2:1.
67' Nuno Mendes (PSG) is about to take a corner kick.
67' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
66' Desire Doue (PSG) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
65' Ooh that was close! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
64' The ball is cleared after Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Fabian Ruiz goes off the pitch and Senny Mayulu (PSG) comes on.
60' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Desire Doue (PSG) replacing Bradley Barcola.
60' Substitution. Joao Neves makes way for Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
59' 1 - 1 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
58' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Donovan Leon comes off his line to gather the ball.
58' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
54' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
53' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
52' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
50' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
49' A snap shot by Ousmane Dembele (PSG) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Donovan Leon produces a good save to thwart him.
49' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
41' Paul Joly (Auxerre) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
37' What a strike! Nuno Mendes (PSG) hits the left post from the free kick.
36' It seemed like Nuno Mendes (PSG) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
34' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Abdelatif Kherradji ignores the protests.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
28' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
26' Joao Neves (PSG) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Auxerre.
26' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) hammers the ball towards the top left corner, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Donovan Leon, who denies him with a terrific save.
22' Vitinha (PSG) makes a slide tackle, but referee Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul. Auxerre are awarded the free kick.
21' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
20' Nuno Mendes (PSG) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
18' Referee Abdelatif Kherradji signals NO PENALTY for PSG after a VAR review!
16' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for PSG! Let's see what he decides.
16' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
15' A long ball forward to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is intercepted.
13' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Donovan Leon is alert and denies him with a nice save.
11' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
11' Nuno Mendes (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
7' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
6' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Joao Neves (PSG) is caught offside!
3' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The first half has started.
PSG will kick the game off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will supervise the game today.
